name: Task Evidence Link
description: Child table row linking an Evidence File to a Compliance Calendar Task. One row per evidence file. Primary evidence is flagged. Use the 'Move Evidence' admin action to reassign evidence to a different task (retains audit trail).

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Fetched from the Evidence File record. E.g. Filing Acknowledgement, Challan, Screenshot.

fields.label: Primary Evidence
fields.description: Mark the most important evidence as primary. Shown prominently in the task detail view and Audit Pack.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.description: Notes on this specific evidence item — e.g. which filing period it covers, why it is relevant.
